title: Only whole grams
text: Only whole grams. It doesn't tell you the exact measurements. Only whole grams no halves. When I put 1 1/2 grams of fluid it weighs as 1 gram.  Not correct.

product_metadata.title: Framar Digital Scale, Hair Color Scale, Kitchen Scale, Food Scale, Gram Scale - Elegant Black
features: 👌 PRECISE MEASUREMENT – Accurate, elegant, easy-to-use digital scale for any of your largest and smallest projects - weighs up to 11 lbs (5000 grams) with precise graduations of 0.05 oz (1 gram).

⚖️ PROFESSIONAL – Unit Button instantly converts between 3 units of measurements (g, oz, lb) and displays results on an easy-to-read LCD screen - e.g. easily converts (539.8 grams) to (1.19 pounds) to (1 pound 3 ounces) to (19.04 ounces)
💯 EASY TARE – Precision Tare Button calculates the net weight of your ingredients by automatically subtracting the weight of any bowl or container. Fantastic as a color scale or kitchen scale.

✨ PRACTICAL DESIGN – Elegant tempered glass top, cleans and stores easily. The sleek design allows you to accent your home, salon, or kitchen with a modern fashion touch and amazing sight, or effortlessly hang the scale stow as a decoration. It’s slim design also makes it easy to store in any cabinet while saving space for the rest of your essentials.

🙌 EASY TO USE – Runs on 2 AAA batteries (Original batteries included) that automatically power-off after 2-minutes to preserve battery life. Improved battery life and quicker calibration/tare feature! The perfect scale to weigh any food, color, items in your day to day needs!
